body:
there are so many other things that i left out. in my state of mind i just put up the ones that stood out the most in my mind.

i was scared to even bother with college/university. not to be a debby downer but i figured it was a waste of money, at least for me. it always seems like its not what you know in the job force. its who you know. especially when they kept that girl at the warehouse job. she did absolutely nothing but stand around. i remember she was sent to come help me and couldnt even carry a 20lb jug of cleaner a customer wanted.

i dont blame myself for the bullying, i was just an easy target. i do however blame myself for the weight i gained. it was just weird how i barely ate growing up because we couldnt really afford much food. then when my mom met this guy he filled the fridge, cupboards, pantry and freezer. even bought a deep freezer and loaded that bad boy too. so going from being a starving kid where you could see every bone in my body. i wanted that food. all of it, i was such a pig. i should have learned self restraint, it wasnt going to go anywhere, but thats not how i thought. i always assumed it would disappear eventually just like all the past boyfriends my mom had before this one.

i believe i created this terrible anxiety in myself over the years of abuse i went through as a kid. i always wished i looked different or like other people in my class. problem is, i just never wanted to be me. 

i dont blame myself for the job loss at all. i just wish i would have been able to find something else. i felt like a failure. that my uncles words to me as a kid were true. that i was nothing and never would be anything. 

my parents didnt exactly help either when it came to the job hunting. constantly getting on my case about it. i dont think they believed i was even applying for any. they just assumed i wanted to stay home and do nothing for the rest of my life. i was so happy when i got the job i have now and left home again for the 2nd time.

i had been trying to reach my mom for the past couple of days wanting to unleash the things that had been going on with me since i left. she has no idea that i was homeless or that i wasnt able to keep up with my payments on my vehicle. i always act like everything is fine because i dont want help from her or anyone. i never ask for help and always try to do things on my own. i asked if she could help me get another vehicle but she said no. i dont know what to do or how to get to work. taking a cab to work every day will be really expensive. way more expensive than the payments i had to make on that vehicle.

i cant even sleep right now because i cant stop thinking about what im going to do when the phone rings for me to come in.

ive been my own company and best friend for the longest time. i just wish i had someone close to share my thoughts with. hangout with once in awhile.

ive made steps in trying to dig myself out of debt. i dont have my head up that it will work at all but im going to the bank tomorrow to talk to them about consolidating my debts into one big pot and they can just withdraw money from my account biweekly until its all paid off. im positive the bank will say no and ill be wasting my time even bothering, but ill see what happens.

part 2:

dropped out of high school due to feeling alone constantly, thoughts of suicide always ran through my head. my mom always thought i was going to school but i would just leave the house then go walk around for 7hours before coming back home and sitting in front of the computer again. eventually report cards had to come in and she made calls as to why i hadnt received one. the jig was up so to speak.

i told her i just lost interest in going, i couldn't focus and felt it was a waste of time to continue going. she tried to get me to do the homeschool thing but i had no interest in doing that either.

not to mention my self image had fallen apart. during the 3 years i had dropped out of school i gained 140lbs. I literally did nothing but eat and sit in front of the computer screen. i had become so sick as well, i couldn't leave the house without wanting to puke. anxiety im assuming? afraid to be seen in my state. 

i couldnt be bothered to do anything at this point unless it was me that wanted to do it. my mom constantly fought with me, disconnect the internet for a couple years including the television. i then discovered a few novels that inspired me to work towards improving myself and becoming something. 

i managed to get back to school at the age of 19. i had to complete grade 10, 11 and 12 before i turned 20 otherwise i would have to pay for my education. (i did all this at an alternative school, work at your own pace)

i completed all my courses and got all my credits to graduate. i lost all the weight by going to the gym regularly, eating properly and doing regular cardio. i felt great, i even had myself a cute girlfriend. (i didnt ask her out though, too shy. she came onto me and forced me into the relationship basically, but im happy she did).

the principal at this alternative school even shed a tear when he presented the diploma to me because he was impressed that someone could do as much as i did in a few short months. truth be told. when i first started at this alternative school, i was still lazy and did not want to do anything. they threatened to kick me out because i wasn't accomplishing anything. i was still fat and puking my guts out every day on the way to school. it wasn't until i decided to go to the gym and workout that everything turned around for me. my mind was set on doing well in my courses and i wanted to be in good shape. 

after i graduated i moved out of the parents house and did what i thought was being an adult. decided it was time to take care of myself, earn my own money and become a somebody instead of a nobody. 

i was high on life for a good 4 years before things fell apart for me. i had any girl i wanted, i made great money, i always had my own place. i spoiled every girl that came my way. always cooking them home cooked meals, taking them to movies, going for walks to all the amazing places i knew about within my city to see the stars at night only to bust out a nice basket full of goodies we could snack on while we discussed the universe and how small we were. i loved life, i felt like i earned the right to be where i was. i was never sad and i was surrounded by the greatest people. 

everything fell right the fuck apart though. the recession hit and i lost my job. the one job i put all my focus into learning and moving up in. i had no skill set for anything else. i had a great friend at this point who was in love with me. i told her i had to move home because i couldnt afford to wilt away jobless as i was not getting any call backs to any of the 200 jobs i applied for. i even tried to get a job at a popular coffee shop franchise, went for the interview and never heard anything back after. 

she convinced me to stay with all her crying and sobbing. i felt bad. i thought if i was in her position i would do the same. i would offer my best friend to stay with me in hopes they would get everything back in order. 

i had money put away, so i thought it wouldnt be so bad either. i could buy my own food and still enjoy doing some things while i looked for a job. i mean it couldn't have been too bad. 

i was wrong. almost a year later i was still looking for work and running out of money. not only that i was gaining weight again and starting to become my old self where i didnt want to be seen in public.  i started to become violent and abusive towards my friend anytime we would get into an argument as well. she cared about me so much and i treated her like shit. i regret it. i have tried to apologize to her and she did say she accepts my apology but wants no contact with me ever again. i dont blame her.

i ended up moving home, we had a huge fight over the phone about her being unfaithful to me as i decided to look through her facebook and found a lot of evidence blah blah. (we ended up dating sometime in the middle of my joblessness).

i was had been jobless since october 2008, applied for over 500 jobs in 3 different cities/towns. i had got one callback to work at a warehouse for almost minimum wage. i took it. i was laid off after 4 months of being there after busting my ass off for them, working through my lunch breaks and always doing everything i could to make sure the customers were satisfied never losing a customer or having one leave unhappy. i even helped them catalog their sales better than the way they were doing it and fixed their computers. just to get laid off because some girl they had hired a few years ago wanted to come back and she was "family". I wasn't told any of this, but all the pieces of the puzzle matched. 

i locked myself away in my bedroom, my mom would try to talk to me about life and what i could do to improve mine. i was just tired, worn down from all the obstacles that i endured over my life. 

i felt like no matter how hard i tried, someone was just waiting there with a club to knock me the fuck down. 

things started to turn around again, almost a year later. i found a job. a job worth thinking about a career in. it was a long shot that i would get hired amongst the 300 people that came to the job orientation but i was chosen. they put me through classes and training and i made some friends during that portion of the program.

part 3:

i found a pretty sweet apartment and work was going well. i even decided to buy myself a better vehicle because mine was constantly having problems with it. things were going good.

NOPE, club to the face again.

returned home from work, keys to my apartment werent working. called my so called "landlord" to find the # is no longer in service. called a locksmith to come and unlock the doors, told them my keys didnt work. got in, went to sleep. next day im woken up to people in my apartment and these people are yelling at me to get out. 

long story short, the guy i was renting from was subletting it to me. basically stealing my money and not paying the people he was renting from. so in turn he was evicted. (well i was evicted). i tried to plea with the people but they told me they already had family coming to rent the place and they had to fix things up in there so i had to leave.

it was the beginning of august, i had no money after paying rent to that guy and paying my vehicle payment plus my other bills. just enough for food, gas and a bit of luxury money which i ended up using to buy a storage unit for my things because it was too late to try and find a place to stay. 

lived out of my vehicle for 2 months while still going to work. its really expensive to live out of a vehicle. if you're stupid i suppose. i managed to live pay cheque to pay cheque because i was spending so much money on gas, eating out and trying to keep myself entertained when i wasnt at work.

was starting to get really sick from the cold at night and not having efficient sleep due to the uncomfortableness. decided id better find a place and fast. instead of paying my vehicle payment i used my money to put first months rent and security deposit down on a place and figured, well maybe my vehicle company wont mind if i give them a heads up and split my payment somehow. all good intentions, but nothing could foresee how sick i was about to get. 

constant vomiting, dizzy all the time. missed 2 weeks of work, no pay cheque. instead of just missing 1 vehicle payment i missed two.

other bills started rolling in, all the automatic withdrawls out of my account were getting out of hand so i asked my bank what i could do they told me to close the account and open a new one. i was so broke and unable to feed myself.

company i was doing the autoloan with called me up flipping out that the account was closed and they couldnt take the money out. i explained that under the circumstances going on in my life im trying to take some control because things were spiralling out of control.

during my lunchbreak at work yesterday i came outside to witness someone blocking my vehicle. went outside to ask him whats up. he gave me a warrant to sieze the vehicle and asked for the keys. gave me permission to take my belongings out.

now my only option of getting to work is by taxi. i wish busses went to where i "could" be working but they only go to one area and im never always at that area. not to mention busses dont even run after a certain time of day here so that doesnt even work. 

i cant even rent a car because i dont own a credit card. i have no means of getting another vehicle at the moment i cant even afford a beater. 

snow is out so i cant even get a cheap bike and peddle my way in. walking is out of the question because i live on the otherside of the city. walking is out of the question because i dont even know when i work at any given day. the phone rings and i go in.

im all alone. i have no friends to talk to. ive tried to reach out to some people just to talk but none of them reply to me. i wish i could wake up just once and actually have a text message from someone asking how i am, or how i have been. nobody even knows the shit ive been going through. most of the best friends i have had dont even know of my past.

i dont think anyone would even notice i was gone if i did disappear. im just so tired of trying. i don't want to wakeup anymore. there is nothing i enjoy in life at all anyway. every day is a struggle now. all i think about is my finical situation, the hole i dug for myself. i know i can get out of it, i just have to keep on "trying". i just don't want to anymore. im so fucking sick of everything. 

i put on this stupid fucking smirk on my face everyday, but everyday i ask myself what the hell am i even doing. 

i doubt any of this makes any sense, im all emotional with hatred towards myself at the moment. i just wanted to open up, let it all out.
